title.zh: 【Phantom 向美国用户上线 Kalshi 预测市场】
title.en: 【Phantom 向美国用户上线 Kalshi 预测市场】

current_state.zh: Phantom began rolling out in-app Kalshi prediction-market trading for US users on October 23, funding trades from Phantom Cash stablecoin balances with $0.02 per-contract fees and blocking certain market categories in Michigan, Nevada and Washington, relying on a conditional CFTC no-action letter covering broker registration.
current_state.en: Phantom began rolling out in-app Kalshi prediction-market trading for US users on October 23, funding trades from Phantom Cash stablecoin balances with $0.02 per-contract fees and blocking certain market categories in Michigan, Nevada and Washington, relying on a conditional CFTC no-action letter covering broker registration.
